observations.data: only facts actually observed or derived by that source

fields.known_facts: current merged ship knowledge, with source and confidence per fact
fields.links: optional references to mission, incident, vessel or database entries

merge_rules: Never import unrevealed authoritative ground truth.
Do not discard contradictory observations; retain provenance and confidence.
Current known fact may change when newer or stronger evidence supersedes it.
Re-identification reuses contact_id only when evidence crosses the configured identity threshold.
